lytham st annes.s1_head: Kitting the events trade of the Fylde Coast
s1loc: Lytham St Annes runs one of Lancashire's biggest open-air concert series. Lytham Festival fills the green by Lytham Windmill each July, drawing huge crowds and headline acts to a temporary arena beside the Ribble estuary, while the refurbished Lowther Pavilion stages shows, drama and live music year-round in its parkland setting. The Waterloo Music Bar carries the grassroots rock and metal scene, and seasonal markets and outdoor events fill the town through the summer.
